newsitem.title: USA: Barringer Tech prices 1.25 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Barringer Tech prices 1.25 mln shr offer.

text.p: Barringer Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it sold 1.25 million shares of its common stock at an initial public offering price of $8.563 per share and 1.25 million warrants at an initial public offering price of $0.05 per warrant.
The shares were sold through an underwriting syndicate led by Janney Montgomery Scott Inc, the company said.
The company said it expected net proceeds from the offering of $9.2 million, and $10.7 million if the underwriters over-allotment option was fully exercised.
Money would be used to fund product development, repay debt, expand the company's manufacturing and assembling capabilities and for working capital and general corporate purposes, it said.

Each warrant was exercisable for one-quarter of a share of common stock at an exercise price of $9.847 per share for three years, the company said. These terms were subject to earlier redemption in certain circumstances, it said.

In connection with the offering, Barringer also said its common stock and the warrants have been approved for inclusion in the NASDAQ National Market System upon official notice of issuance. The offering was expected to close on November 15, it said.
